name: Badugi
description: Badugi is a unique and fascinating poker variant characterized by its triple-draw mechanic and four-card hand structure. Unlike traditional poker, where flushes and straights are valued, Badugi is a 'lowball' game that penalizes matching suits and ranks. The ultimate goal is to hold a 'Badugi'â€”four cards of distinct suits and distinct ranks, with the lowest possible values. It's a game of deception, probability, and ruthless discarded-card tracking.

history.origins: The exact origins are debated, with strong claims from both South Korea (where the name 'Badugi' refers to a black-and-white spotted dog) and Canada (where it was played as 'Off Suit Lowball' in the 1980s).
timeline: 1980s: Variations appear in Canadian pool halls and South Korean social clubs.
2000s: Introduced to online poker platforms, gaining a cult following.
2008: Added to the World Series of Poker (WSOP) as part of mixed games.
Present: A staple in high-stakes '8-Game' and 'H.O.R.S.E.' mixes.
history.cultural: In Korea, the game is a popular television and online gambling pastime.
history.evolution: Badugi evolved from 5-card triple draw by stripping away the fifth card to make achieving a 'four-suit' hand statistically challenging and rewarding.

setup.players: 2-8 players. Typically played with a dealer button and small/big blinds.
setup.deck: Standard 52 cards. Aces are always LOW.
setup.dealing: Each player is dealt 4 cards face down.
setup.equipment: Standard pack, poker chips, dealer button.

rules.objective: Capture the pot by holding the lowest qualifying hand at showdown. A 4-card 'Badugi' (all different suits/ranks) is the highest tier of hand.
rules.gameplay: 1. **First Betting Round**: Following the blinds. 2. **First Draw**: Players discard any number of cards (0-4) and receive replacements. 3. **Second Betting Round**. 4. **Second Draw**. 5. **Third Betting Round**. 6. **Third Draw**. 7. **Final Betting Round**. 8. **Showdown**.
keyRules: No Suits Rank: All suits are of equal value for winning purposes.
Aces Low: The Ace is the best (lowest) card.
The 'Nuts': The best hand is A-2-3-4 of four different suits.

strategy.basic: Prioritize 'Badugi' potential. If you are dealt 3 cards of the same suit, you MUST discard two of them, leaving you with a very weak 2-card hand.
strategy.intermediate: Snowing (Bluffing): In a triple draw game, you can 'Pat' (discard 0 cards) to make opponents think you already have a powerful Badugi, forcing them to fold or play defensively.
strategy.advanced: Range Analysis: If an opponent draws only 1 card on the first draw and then stands pat on the second, they almost certainly have a completed Badugi. If that Badugi is an 8-high or better, you should fold unless you are drawing to a 7-high or better.
tips: Don't fall in love with a King-high Badugi. It might be a 4-card hand, but it is easily beaten by a 3-card hand that happens to be A-2-3.
Pay attention to 'Board Cards' (what you have discarded). If you've discarded three Aces, your chances of drawing an Ace-high Badugi are significantly reduced.

variations.name: Half-Pot Badugi
variations.description: The pot is split between the best Badugi and the best traditional High hand (very rare).
variations.emptyOverridesReason: This variant only changes pot splitting between Badugi and a separate high hand; the underlying draw structure and engine phases match base Badugi.

variations.name: Badeucy
variations.description: A split-pot game between Badugi (4 cards) and 2-7 Lowball (5 cards).
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Badeucy combines Badugi and 2-7 triple draw; detailed engine overrides for the mixed hand evaluation are intentionally deferred to a dedicated blueprint.

scoring.winCondition: Lowest hand at showdown or all other players fold.

synthesis.shortDescription: Master one of the most unique variants in modern poker. In Badugi, you draw three times to build a four-card hand where every suit and every rank is unique. Outwit your opponents in this game of perfect information vs. stealthy bluffs.

hero.title: BADUGI
hero.subtitle: The Spotted Dog
hero.tagline: Different suits, different ranks, and as low as you can go. The ultimate triple-draw showdown.
